facts.fact: The Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality states that it is the sole official body in Egypt for preparing and issuing Egyptian standards, set up by Presidential Decree 2 of 1957 and renamed by Presidential Decree 83 of 2005; the page is undated, and the year is that of the latest decision it records, 2024. Written by the parent: the drafter's file for this document was overwritten.
